This module joins that declaration to the tree and to the ledger of recorded runs, and reports, per rule, whether what it names is there, whether a runner owns it, whether it was ever run, whether the run passed, and whether the run is older than what it is about. A blocking rule whose proof is missing, dangling or failing is a finding, because a rule nobody can prove is a rule nobody enforces.</t4><t5>3 capabilities · behaviorally_verified</t5>

Tento modul spojuje tuto deklaraci se stromem a s knihou zaznamenaných běhů a hlásí pro každé pravidlo, zda to, co jmenuje, existuje, zda ho vlastní nějaký runner, zda byl kdy spuštěn, zda běh prošel a zda je běh starší než to, čeho se týká. Blokující pravidlo, jehož důkaz chybí, visí nebo selhává, je nález, protože pravidlo, které nikdo nedokáže dokázat, je pravidlo, které nikdo nevynucuje.</t4><t5>3 schopnosti · behaviorally_verified</t5>

en: <t1>No gap between the picture and the stream.</t1> The subscription is the request target, naming its topics and, for the journal, carrying the logical clock the client last drew, as an execution's carries its sequence. The board has no history to replay: its subscription opens with the whole board as it stands, then each change. The server subscribes first, replays every retained event after that clock, then goes live, so an event appended while the page was being read is written once and is never lost between the read and the subscription. A clock the journal no longer holds is answered as <t2/> answers it, expired, and the client reads its page again before it draws another event. A client that falls behind receives <t3/> and does the same. Nothing is skipped in silence.

Server se přihlásí první, přehraje každou zadrženou událost po těchto hodinách, pak jde živě, takže událost připojená během čtení stránky se zapíše jednou a nikdy se neztratí mezi čtením a odběrem.
